narrative.overview: THORAL frames creative engineering as a precision-machined industrial artifact suspended between split obsidian and smoked-slate studio planes. Rather than relying on decorative gradients, glowing neon borders, or uniform SaaS card rows, the interface uses stepped dark architectural volumes, 1px warm-bone seams, weight-contrasted geometric display type, and a real-time WebGL anodized monolith occluding an incandescent forged-orange orbital halo.
keyCharacteristics: Calibrated four-zone dark architectural planes separating sections and hero volumes without heavy borders.
Extreme weight-contrast display typography pairing ExtraBold (800) architectural stems directly against ExtraLight (200) hairline uppercase counterpoints.
Real-time Three.js PBR anodized metal surfaces with procedural sandblasted grain and occluded Fresnel thermal rim light.
100% custom geometric SVG emblem, technical plates, and stroke iconography with zero emojis.

rules.name: The Four-Zone Plane Rule
rules.body: Dark grounds never collapse into flat #000000 or muddy gray; every structural layer steps intentionally across Abyssal Void, Matte Obsidian, Smoked Slate, and Floating Slab.

rules.name: The Surgical Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange reserves its presence for the occluded 3D orbital halo, the primary conversion trigger, and active depth-rail or tab registration.

rules.name: The Weight-Counterpoint Rule
rules.body: Every major heading pairs an ExtraBold (800) primary word with an ExtraLight (200) uppercase companion instead of relying on decorative eyebrows or kickers above headings.

rules.name: The Physical Occlusion Rule
rules.body: Spatial hierarchy comes first from tonal plane steps and real 3D occlusion in the WebGL stage, supported by directional Y-offset studio shadows.

dos: Do separate adjacent structural regions using the four calibrated dark plane tokens and 1px warm-bone seams (rgba(238, 232, 223, 0.08)).
Do lead every section directly with bold/hairline weight-contrasted Urbanist Variable headings without placing small kicker labels above them.
Do maintain min-height: 44px on all interactive controls and preserve prefers-reduced-motion state transitions without spatial motion.
donts: Don't introduce emojis or Unicode symbols anywhere in UI or metadata; author 1.6px stroke SVGs or geometric marks.
Don't apply gradient fills to typography or zero-offset colored glow shadows to containers.
Don't arrange projects or capabilities into uniform three-column icon-heading-paragraph card grids.
